TK-LU01-LA02 | UNIT 1 LEARNING ACTIVITY

Trusted roles and controls

Select a role to see the safeguard that prevents an individual from being left to act alone under pressure.

Why this matters:

A safe response is a team response

Telecommunications businesses depend on trusted people and well-designed controls. These roles are examples; your organisation’s actual incident plan and contacts always take priority.

Summary: controls protect people

In a pressured situation, no one should improvise outside their role. The most protective action is to activate the designated response process and allow independent checks, approvals and welfare support to work together.

Practical takeaway: Know your approved escalation contact, keep it available through a trusted channel, and do not make an exceptional operational, financial or information decision alone.
